Gateway route audit, 2026-10-30

Images: jellyfin/jellyfin:10.11.11 and jellyfin/jellyfin:12.4.20261026-211555.
Read Jellyfin.Api controller authorization attributes in v10.11.11 source and
current source, then cross-check the actual Jellyfin.Api.dll CustomAttribute
metadata from BOTH pinned images (controller inheritance + method attributes).
RequiresElevation, FirstTimeSetupOrElevated and LocalAccessOrRequiresElevation
produce 85 unique path templates with their elevated methods, recorded in
gateway-elevated-routes.json. The image metadata additionally contains
/Startup/FirstUser and the historical /LiveTv/Tuners/Discvover alias.

Removed 87 administrative templates from the original 356, and replaced the
arbitrary /System/Configuration/{key} template with /System/Configuration/Encoding.
Retained GET /System/Configuration for jellyfin-web member UI/playback settings;
its elevated POST is refused. Other paths shared by member reads and elevated
mutations (items, images, users) retain member operations only.
Also refuse library setup/options and external update hooks: these dashboard or
integration operations lack elevated authorization in Jellyfin.
Added six legacy member templates. Final table: 275 distinct templates.

Web audit: docker cp IMAGE:/jellyfin/jellyfin-web DIRECTORY (using a temporary
container), then node scripts/extract-jellyfin-web-routes.mjs DIRECTORY.
The reviewer-provided getUrl extractor finds 194 unique strings in 10.11.11
and 192 in 12.4. The fixture explicitly separates member URLs from dashboard,
retired SDK, Quick Connect, and incomplete/overcaptured dynamic expressions.
122 member examples include completed dynamic strings and explicit UserData,
legacy playback start/stop and encoding configuration checks. They are a
regression inventory, not a promise that every SDK compatibility URL is still
implemented by both servers. Both real-server runs exercise member discovery,
item playback, stream ranges, HLS, playback reports, socket upgrades and the
legacy SpecialFeatures URL, plus refusals without upstream traffic.
